Changes

🏆 Added new Challenge - World Ender Asteroids!! Protect the local colony by destroying the asteroid before it wipes out the colony! Each world ender asteroid has more health than the previous. How far can you go?? Your ship, Laser Mining Turret and Mining Drone's "mining amount" is converted to damage against these apocalyptic asteroids. Reduce them to rubble before they pass by. notes.title: Update v0.0.59 2023-12-22 (Steam Build 13033567)

Fixes

 Mining Boost save/load increasing actual number of boosts in inventory
 Reputation wipe will now also reset current RPS (resource per second)


Changes 

 Disable menu while warping
 Remove forge while warping, and zones outside of Asteroid Field 1001
 Merchant 'set amounts for all' option text updated
 Adjust Research menu, to include layout, button text colors for different states, size, etc. - Should be much easier to use
 Move notification history file alongside save game file instead of root player folder


Additions 

 New Warp Zone, AFA2600, a Restricted Area. A maze to navigate to retrieve the rewards. Maze changes every time. Collect the rewards before the time runs out and an emergency warp kicks in and sends you back to AF1001.
 Playtime Rewards! 1 granted for 15 minutes of playtime, once a day. 1 for 30 minutes, 3x times a day (minutes do not have to be contiguous)
 Reward icon will display in main zone near lower-left icons if you have a reward to be redeemed in your cargo.
 Queue view for Research - Displays queued items up to the max 5
 Queue view informs if Queue has been unlocked, and if not, that the T10 research is required.
 Warp Status added to Hover Over text on Warp Zone Button to quickly see which warps are ready
 Shop remembers Quantity selection, added to save system
 New research - Range increase for Laser Mining Turrets (LMTs)
 Tracking stats for warp zone visits
 Added "Away from Home" tracking. When you are outside the home warp zone, your time is tracked, and ore is granted based on your RPS and time away. Must be unlocked through crafting and research.
 New Click Factory Crafting - AI CPU Chips, Drone, LMT and AutoMiner Parts. Used for Advanced Research Recipes to enable 'Away from Home' mining operations.
 New Advanced Research Recipes, Management Operations, Drone Operations, LMT Operations, AutoMiner Operations - Unlocks the 'Away from Home' mining operations.
 New ore, Titanium (Ti)
 Added Hidden Safe - each safe hides 10x of the 5 Jewels. Safe cost increases with each purchase. Protects the Jewels from seizure during reset for new Reputation runs. - Crafted in Click Factory.
 Added AI Optimized Cargo - works like regular cargo purchased from the store but are crafted in the Click Factory using parts and ore. Slight cost increase for each craft.
 Add Mining Drones purchased to Stats view
 Added Pagination to the Notification History, along with current/total page display.
 Added touch scroll to notification, cargo, merchant, and settings views for better accessibility 


New Systems

 Tracking time away from home zone AF1001, using RPS and time away, we grant ore that would have been gained. Also unlocks Offline gain.
 Offline rewards ore is put through the same RNG system as active mining.
 Must be unlocked with crafting in factory for specialized components and using those components in special research.
 New category in Research for the Factory recipes


-- Specialized Components -- Crafted in Factory -- Requires T10 research unlocked to craft 

 AI CPU Chips (100k each Si, Au, Mg, Cu)
 Drone Parts (100k each Ti, C, Cu, Si)
 LMT Parts (100k each Si, Fe, Cu, Pt)
 AutoMiner Parts (100k each Si, C, Ni, Ag)


-- Special Research - Factory Operations -- Uses Crafted Specialized Components 

 Management Operations - Learn to manage factory operations - AI CPU Chips X 25 + 25 aquaite,  25 azureite, 25 lazurite + 1e8 gold
 Drone Operations - Learn to maintain and operate drones - Drone Parts X 25 + 25 aquaite,  25 azureite, 25 lazurite + 1e8 gold
 LMT Operations - Learn to maintain and operate LMTs - LMT Parts X 25 + 25 aquaite,  25 azureite, 25 lazurite + 1e8 gold
 AutoMiner Operations - Learn to maintain and operate AutoMiners - AutoMiner Parts X 25 + 25 aquaite,  25 azureite, 25 lazurite + 1e8 gold


 -- Offline Rewards are available, but must be unlocked 

 Management Droids grant 1% offline gains based on RPS at game exit
